title: Dispatch: split composed subrace ASI text and Eldritch Invocations option list into verbatim spans (attempt 1)
description:
Implementation dispatch for parent eshyra-o9bd.19.2.1.3 (read it with `bd show eshyra-o9bd.19.2.1.3`). All design decisions below are made; do not re-decide them. If reality contradicts this spec, STOP, record what you found with `bd update <this-id> --append-notes`, and close with a reason rather than improvising.

Defect class: a value emitted at a pointer field-provenance-v1 declares `source-prose` (verbatim SRD text) that is actually composed from two separately printed source spans. Fix: each source-prose value must be ONE verbatim span. Read docs/importer-fix-protocol.md first. Do NOT touch docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/freeze-manifest.json or add thaw notes (freeze guard intentionally dormant).

All paths below are relative to packages/core/.

=== MEMBER A: flattened subrace Ability Score Increase (high-elf, hill-dwarf, lightfoot-halfling, rock-gnome) ===
Pack today: subrace /traits/0 is {name:"Ability Score Increase", text:"Your Dexterity score increases by 2. Your Intelligence score increases by 1."} and /abilityScoreIncreases is ONE entry whose sourceText is the same joined string. The two sentences are printed in different sections (parent race traits vs subrace block).

A1. scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/parseAncestries.ts `mergeTraits`: stop concatenating a subrace trait into a same-label parent trait. Every subrace trait is appended as its own entry after the parent traits (parent's "Subrace" pointer trait still dropped). Result for high-elf: parent "Ability Score Increase" (Dex +2 sentence) stays in parent position; the subrace's own "Ability Score Increase" (Int +1 sentence) appears as a separate entry in subrace order. Duplicate trait NAMES are intended: the SRD prints the label twice. Update the module/function doc comments (the "flattened" decision now means parent traits + subrace traits as separate verbatim entries, never text-joined).

A2. Rock Gnome boundary (registry row rock-gnome-boundary, aliases indep:010 / sol:CAP-012): `TRAIT_LABEL_RE` (parseAncestries.ts ~line 115) does not accept the typographic apostrophe U+2019, so "Artificer’s Lore." is not recognised as a trait label and its body bleeds into the preceding Ability Score Increase trait. Accept U+2019 alongside ASCII ' in the label character class. After the fix rock-gnome must have a separate trait named "Artificer’s Lore" (printed apostrophe preserved) whose text is the Artificer's Lore body, and the existing expertise `mechanics` projection must end up on THAT trait, not on the ASI trait. Find where the ancestry trait mechanics projection is attached (grep "expertise" in scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/) and make sure it keys on the Artificer’s Lore trait. Check whether any other races-section trait label changes as a result of the regex change and report it in notes.

A3. scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/creationFacts.ts `ANCESTRY_ABILITY_SCORE_INCREASES`: change the value type to an array (`readonly AncestryAbilityScoreIncrease[]`) for every ancestry. Parent/non-subrace ancestries keep exactly one entry (unchanged content). The four subraces get TWO entries in document order: the parent's (e.g. high-elf: {fixed:[{dexterity,2}], sourceText:"Your Dexterity score increases by 2."}) then the subrace's own ({fixed:[{intelligence,1}], sourceText:"Your Intelligence score increases by 1."}). hill-dwarf: Con+2 / Wis+1; lightfoot-halfling: Dex+2 / Cha+1; rock-gnome: Int+2 / Con+1. `enrichAncestryCreationFacts` emits `abilityScoreIncreases: entries.map(cloneAbilityScoreIncreases)`.

A4. src/character/srdAncestryAbilityScoreIncreases.ts oracle: same array shape per key, same entries as A3. Rename the accessor to `getAncestryAbilityScoreIncreases(key): readonly AncestryAbilityScoreIncrease[] | undefined`, update src/internal.ts export and callers (test/srdAncestryAbilityScoreIncreases.test.ts, scripts/create-dnd5e-srd-audit-bundle/cli.ts ~line 768). Runtime consumers already sum across entries (characterDraft.ts / dnd5eRecipe.ts flatMap `fixed`; requiredChoices.ts finds the `choice` entry; derivedValues.ts sums by ability) — verify, do not change behavior. Net level-1 ability bonuses for every ancestry must be identical before and after.

A5. Tests. Update test/srdAncestryAbilityScoreIncreases.test.ts: resolved record abilityScoreIncreases toEqual the oracle array; STRENGTHEN the faithfulness check from `startsWith` to: the multiset of ASI-trait texts (traits named /ability score increase/i) equals, one-to-one and in order, the multiset of oracle sourceText values (exact string equality). Update test/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/parseAncestries.test.ts and emit.test.ts expectations that encoded the joined text (the SRD proves the old expectation wrong — say so in the commit message; this is not weakening). Add, in parseAncestries.test.ts where the pinned PDF is already extracted (it imports extractPdfText), a durable invariant over ALL parsed ancestries: every trait `text` is one contiguous span of the extracted races-section source text after normalization (collapse all whitespace runs to one space; rejoin line-break hyphenation the same way the parser's joinParagraphs does — read it). It must FAIL on current main's parser output for the four subraces and rock-gnome (prove this by running it before your A1/A2 change and record the failing record list in your notes). If a record fails for an unrelated extraction artifact, do not loosen the normalizer broadly — record it in notes and stop.

=== MEMBER B: feature:warlock:eldritch-invocations /description ===
scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/parseFeatures.ts (~line 615-640): when a feature anchor repeats, the second body is appended into `description`. A probe on the pinned PDF shows exactly two repeats: `class Cleric destroy undead` (p17, the in-body table caption, CONTIGUOUS: the repeat is the very line that ended the first body) and `class Warlock eldritch invocations` (first body p47, repeat p48 = the end-of-chapter option-list section ~3,000 characters later). Only the latter is a member.

B1. Track, per emitted key, the index `j` at which its body ended. On a repeat at index `i`: if `i === bodyEnd` (contiguous continuation) keep today's merge unchanged (Destroy Undead must stay byte-identical — verify). Otherwise the repeat opens a DISTANT section: store its body as a new `optionCatalog: string` on the FeatureExtraction (types.ts, doc comment: "an end-of-chapter option-list section the feature body points to, printed apart from the body; one verbatim span, never joined into description"), keep `description` as the first body only, and still merge `optionSourcePages` from the catalog body. If a key receives a second distant section, throw (fail closed). If Destroy Undead turns out NOT to satisfy `i === bodyEnd`, stop and report — do not add a name-based exception.

B2. scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/emit.ts `buildFeatureData`: emit `optionCatalog` when present, placed right after `description`.

B3. scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/deriveFeatureChoices.ts: option-catalog parsing (`parseOptionCatalog`, and any choose-count/list parsing that needs the option headings) must read `optionCatalog` when present, else `description`. Count words ("two eldritch invocations") stay parsed from `description` (the p47 body carries "At 2nd level, you gain two eldritch invocations"). The derived `choices` for eldritch-invocations must be byte-identical to main (32 options, same ids/text/prerequisites/source pages).

B4. scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/fieldProvenanceDeclarations.ts: declare `prose('feature', '/optionCatalog', ...)` with a reason stating it is the printed end-of-chapter option-list section, one verbatim span, kept apart from /description. src/rules/kindSchemas.ts: register `optionCatalog` as an optional non-empty string on feature data (follow the existing feature validator's idiom). src/rules/srdChoiceProseAudit.ts `scanProse`: also push `data.optionCatalog` so no prose is hidden from that gate.

B5. Tests: in test/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/parseFeatures.test.ts extend the existing 'end-of-chapter option list re-uses the feature heading' describe: description equals the first body only; optionCatalog equals the option-list body; a contiguous repeated caption still merges into description; two distant repeats for one key throw. Add a generated-pack assertion (test/srdGeneratedPack.test.ts or the nearest existing feature assertion) that feature:warlock:eldritch-invocations description does not contain "If an eldritch invocation has prerequisites" and optionCatalog starts with it.

=== REGENERATE + VERIFY ===
Regenerate the committed pack through the importer: `npm run import:dnd5e-srd -- --pdf packages/core/sources/dnd5e-srd-5.1/SRD_CC_v5.1.pdf --out packages/core/data/rules-packs/rules__dnd5e-srd-5.1/` (from the worktree root), then `npm run verify:dnd5e-srd-pack` must be exact. Regenerate any derived artifact a test says is stale (e.g. the o9bd-18-8-8 semi-structured boundary inventory, field-provenance.json) with its own generator — never hand-edit. Expected pack diff: only the 4 subraces + rock-gnome ancestry records, feature:warlock:eldritch-invocations, field-provenance.json, and whatever source-coverage/inventory artifacts legitimately move; explain every other changed file in notes. Record-count pins must not change.

Run `npm run verify:worktree` from the worktree root BEFORE committing (it rewrites files). Memory is tight (~7 GB): if rulesPackAuditCli or dolt tests time out under load, rerun with VITEST_MAX_FORKS=4.
Commit message prefix: `eshyra-o9bd.19.2.1.3 ` and end with `Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>`.
Completion report via `bd update <this-id> --append-notes`: commit SHA, pack-diff record list, the pre-fix failing list from A5, Destroy Undead byte-identity confirmation, choices byte-identity confirmation, verify:worktree result.

MEMBER A (subrace ASI): parseAncestries.ts mergeTraits no longer joins a
subrace trait into a same-named parent trait; every subrace trait is
appended as its own entry after the parent's, in document order. Duplicate
"Ability Score Increase" labels are intended (high-elf, hill-dwarf,
lightfoot-halfling, rock-gnome each now carry two separate ASI-named
traits: parent's sentence first, subrace's own second). TRAIT_LABEL_RE now
accepts U+2019 alongside ASCII apostrophe, fixing rock-gnome's
"Artificer's Lore." label recognition; checked the whole races section for
other lines this could affect (grep for U+2019 in a fresh PDF extraction) --
"Artificer's Lore. Whenever you make an" is the only line matching the
capitalized-X's-Y. shape the regex change touches, so no other races-
section trait label changed. The expertise mechanics projection
(deriveFeatureMechanics, called per-trait in emit.ts) now attaches to the
Artificer's Lore trait automatically, not the ASI trait -- verified in the
regenerated pack.

ANCESTRY_ABILITY_SCORE_INCREASES (creationFacts.ts + the
srdAncestryAbilityScoreIncreases.ts oracle) is now Record<string,
readonly AncestryAbilityScoreIncrease[]>: 1 entry for a normal ancestry, 2
(parent then subrace) for the four SRD 5.1 subraces (high-elf: Dex+2 then
Int+1; hill-dwarf: Con+2 then Wis+1; lightfoot-halfling: Dex+2 then Cha+1;
rock-gnome: Int+2 then Con+1). Oracle accessor renamed
getAncestryAbilityScoreIncrease -> getAncestryAbilityScoreIncreases
(returns readonly array | undefined); updated src/internal.ts export and
both callers (test/srdAncestryAbilityScoreIncreases.test.ts,
scripts/create-dnd5e-srd-audit-bundle/cli.ts ~line 765). Runtime consumers
(dnd5eRecipe.ts / characterDraft.ts) already flatMap(entry => entry.fixed)
across abilityScoreIncreases[], and requiredChoices.ts/derivedValues.ts
already operate on the flattened bonus list, so net level-1 ability bonuses
are byte-identical before/after for every ancestry -- verified via the
strengthened srdAncestryAbilityScoreIncreases.test.ts (new "sums subrace
entries to the same net level-1 bonus" test) and the full character-
creation test suite (characterCreation.test.ts, characterCreationRecipe.
test.ts, characterDraftEngine.test.ts, rulesPackCharacterResolver.test.ts
all pass unchanged).

A5 durable invariant: added to parseAncestries.test.ts (real-PDF describe
block) -- every parsed trait text must be one contiguous span of the
extracted races-section source text after whitespace-collapse
normalization (mirrors joinParagraphs' own single-space line-join; there is
no separate hyphenation-rejoin step in joinParagraphs to replicate). Ran it
against pre-fix parseAncestries.ts (temporarily restored via `git show
HEAD:...` before this commit, then restored the fix) to confirm it FAILS on
current-main's parser: failing list was exactly
  ["High Elf / Ability Score Increase", "Hill Dwarf / Ability Score Increase",
   "Lightfoot Halfling / Ability Score Increase", "Rock Gnome / Ability Score Increase"]
-- the 4 subraces the bead named, each on its single (pre-fix, merged) ASI
trait. Passes after the fix (34/34 in that test file).

parseAncestries.test.ts's "merges the additive ability score increase into
one trait" tests for Hill Dwarf and Mountain Dwarf, and emit.test.ts's
HILL_DWARF_ANCESTRY fixture, encoded the old joined-text behavior; replaced
with two-separate-verbatim-entries expectations per docs/importer-fix-
protocol.md's "SRD source text proves the expected value is wrong" -- not a
weakening.

MEMBER B (Eldritch Invocations): parseFeatures.ts now tracks bodyEndByKey
(the flat-line index each feature key's body last ended at). A repeat whose
heading index equals that stored bodyEnd is a CONTIGUOUS continuation (the
repeat heading IS the line that bounded the prior body -- Cleric's Destroy
Undead in-body table caption) and merges into description exactly as
before; confirmed byte-identical (still exactly 1 Destroy Undead record,
table contents still in description, new explicit test asserts
optionCatalog stays undefined for it). Any other repeat is DISTANT and is
captured as a new `optionCatalog` field on FeatureExtraction / emitted
feature data, kept apart from description; optionSourcePages still merges
from it either way. A second distant repeat for the same key throws
(new regression test WARLOCK_ELDRITCH_INVOCATIONS_TWO_DISTANT_REPEATS
confirms the throw message).

emit.ts emits optionCatalog right after description (buildFeatureData).
deriveFeatureChoices.ts's parseOptionCatalog call sites (the generic
OPTION_CATALOG_SPECS path and the Champion Additional Fighting Style
special case) now read featureOptionCatalog(feature) ?? description; the
choose-count word parse ("two eldritch invocations") is untouched and still
reads description only, per spec. fieldProvenanceDeclarations.ts declares
feature//optionCatalog as prose; kindSchemas.ts's validateDnd5eFeature
registers it via optStr (optional non-empty string); srdChoiceProseAudit.ts's
scanProse also pushes data.optionCatalog.

CHOICES BYTE-IDENTITY: confirmed via direct JSON comparison of old vs
regenerated records.json --
  o['data']['choices'] == n['data']['choices']  ->  True
for feature:warlock:eldritch-invocations (32 options, same ids/text/
prerequisites/source pages) -- see the new srdGeneratedPack.test.ts
describe "eldritch invocations option list stays a separate optionCatalog".

REGENERATE + VERIFY: `npm run import:dnd5e-srd -- --pdf .../SRD_CC_v5.1.pdf

ONE INCIDENTAL, EXPLAINED DIFF: feature:warlock:eldritch-invocations lost
its top-level data.mechanics block (a long-rest resource, blinded/

bodies that were only reachable to deriveFeatureMechanics because they were
wrongly joined into description pre-fix; mechanics projection only ever

longer matches. Grepped src/ and test/ for any consumer of this specific
block -- none exists (the per-option prerequisites/text are already
structured via `choices`, confirmed unchanged above). Updated
srdGeneratedPack.test.ts's EXPECTED_PARTIAL_FIELDS reviewed baseline
(feature.mechanics missingCount 48 -> 49; new feature.optionCatalog row
missingCount 183/184) with the explanation inline. Filed follow-up
eshyra-x49h (P3) to decide whether option-catalog features should get
per-option mechanics projection -- not required by this bead's scope
(source-fidelity/verbatim-span correctness) and not a regression against
any live consumer.

Also regenerated docs/inventories/o9bd-18-8-8-semi-structured-boundary.{json,md}
via its own generator (scripts/inventory-semi-structured-boundary.ts,
no --check flag = write mode) -- test/semiStructuredBoundaryInventory.test.ts
flagged it stale against the new pack shape; diff is population-count-only
plus the new data.optionCatalog row, all traceable to the same fix.

VERIFICATION: npm run verify:dnd5e-srd-pack (exact match) · npm run clean
&& npm run typecheck (clean) · npm run test (306 files, 5356 passed, 3
